brief:
Charges against five former and current Stanford University students will be dismissed in relation to a 2024 pro-Palestinian demonstration in which protesters barricaded themselves inside the school, according to Reuters. The decision marks a reversal for prosecutors pursuing the case stemming from the campus occupation.

The protesters had occupied a Stanford building as part of demonstrations calling for the university to divest from Israel, an action that drew significant attention during the broader campus pro-Palestinian movement in 2024.

title: Stanford drops charges against pro-Palestinian student protesters
